title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Asha Patel
description:
This PR adds a set of RAG quickstarts, agent/tool-calling examples (Python and TypeScript), and the necessary docs site updates to surface the new content. Motivation: make it easy for developers to get started with Redwood's RAG templates and agent tool-calling patterns via copyable quickstarts and runnable examples. Changes include new example templates, step-by-step quickstart guides, docs site MDX pages, sidebar updates, and a small CI/docs-build fix so the site build passes in CI.

Details:
- New quickstart guide: docs/guides/rag/quickstart.md with step-by-step instructions and a minimal template.
- Agent/tool-calling examples: examples/agents/tool-caller/python_example.py and examples/agents/tool-caller/ts_example.ts. The examples demonstrate function/tool calling, sandboxed tool registration, and a simple RAG loop using prefix caching.
- RAG templates: examples/rag/basic-template.yaml and a README with recommended param tuning for batching and cache TTLs.
- Docs site updates: website/src/pages/docs/rag.mdx and website/src/pages/docs/agents/tool-calling.mdx added; website/src/sidebar.json updated to include the new pages.
- CI: fixed docs build step in .github/workflows/docs-build.yml (missing node version pin caused intermittent failures) and added a lightweight smoke test under tests/docs_smoke/test_rag_quickstart.py to catch regressions.

Notes on review: small code changes were requested for clarity and a missing import in the Python example; those were addressed in follow-up commits. All CI checks are green and documentation was copy-edited for tone and consistency with existing quickstarts.
